title: The Professor’s Secret Account
description: I just retired from the army and went back to school, and I was in a normal college life. If you can’t afford it, you’ll be able to apply for a lecture that you really don’t want to hear. The reason why Ji-woo is reluctant to lecture is that he has been treated unfairly by Hayoung in the past. Crying and listening to Hayoung’s lecture while eating mustard. Unsurprisingly, I found Hayoung’s deviant account.
